headline: Executive order changes an earlier order that set import duties tied to the situation at the U.S. southern border.
what_it_does: This order amends an earlier executive order that placed duties, which are taxes on imported goods, as a response to conditions at the southern border. The title suggests these duties apply to goods coming from Mexico. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that import goods from Mexico
who_it_affects.how: The order may change the duties they pay on those goods.

who_it_affects.group: Mexican exporters selling to the U.S.
who_it_affects.how: Changes to the duties could affect the cost of selling their goods in the U.S. market.
